record.bible_text: And the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> against the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> of Israel<WH03478>, prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> unto the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802>; Woe<WH01945> <FI>be<Fi> to the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> of Israel<WH03478> that do feed<WH07462><WTH8802> themselves! should not the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> feed<WH07462><WTH8799> the flocks<WH06629>?

Ye eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the fat<WH02459>, and ye clothe<WH03847><WTH8799> you with the wool<WH06785>, ye kill<WH02076><WTH8799> them that are fed<WH01277>: <FI>but<Fi> ye feed<WH07462><WTH8799> not the flock<WH06629>.

The diseased<WH02470><WTH8737> have ye not strengthened<WH02388><WTH8765>, neither have ye healed<WH07495><WTH8765> that which was sick<WH02470><WTH8802>, neither have ye bound up<WH02280><WTH8804> <FI>that which was<Fi> broken<WH07665><WTH8737>, neither have ye brought again<WH07725><WTH8689> that which was driven away<WH05080><WTH8737>, neither have ye sought<WH01245><WTH8765> that which was lost<WH06><WTH8802>; but with force<WH02394> and with cruelty<WH06531> have ye ruled<WH07287><WTH8804> them.

And they were scattered<WH06327><WTH8799>, because <FI>there is<Fi> no shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>: and they became meat<WH0402> to all the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704>, when they were scattered<WH06327><WTH8799>. <RF>because...: or, without a shepherd<Rf>

My sheep<WH06629> wandered<WH07686><WTH8799> through all the mountains<WH02022>, and upon every high<WH07311><WTH8802> hill<WH01389>: yea, my flock<WH06629> was scattered<WH06327><WTH8738> upon all the face<WH06440> of the earth<WH0776>, and none did search<WH01875><WTH8802> or seek<WH01245><WTH8764> <FI>after them<Fi> .<CM>
Therefore, ye shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>;

<FI> As<Fi> I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, surely because my flock<WH06629> became a prey<WH0957>, and my flock<WH06629> became meat<WH0402> to every beast<WH02416> of the field<WH07704>, because <FI>there was<Fi> no shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>, neither did my shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> search<WH01875><WTH8804> for my flock<WH06629>, but the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> fed<WH07462><WTH8799> themselves, and fed<WH07462><WTH8804> not my flock<WH06629>; <RF>because...: or, without a shepherd<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I <FI>am<Fi> against the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802>; and I will require<WH01875><WTH8804> my flock<WH06629> at their hand<WH03027>, and cause them to cease<WH07673><WTH8689> from feeding<WH07462><WTH8800> the flock<WH06629>; neither shall the shepherds<WH07462><WTH8802> feed<WH07462><WTH8799> themselves any more; for I will deliver<WH05337><WTH8689> my flock<WH06629> from their mouth<WH06310>, that they may not be meat<WH0402> for them.
For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I, <FI>even<Fi> I, will both search<WH01875><WTH8804> my sheep<WH06629>, and seek them out<WH01239><WTH8765>.

As a shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802> seeketh out<WH01243> his flock<WH05739> in the day<WH03117> that he is among<WH08432> his sheep<WH06629> <FI>that are<Fi> scattered<WH06567><WTH8737>; so will I seek out<WH01239><WTH8762> my sheep<WH06629>, and will deliver<WH05337><WTH8689> them out of all places<WH04725> where they have been scattered<WH06327><WTH8738> in the cloudy<WH06051> and dark<WH06205> day<WH03117>. <RF>As...: Heb. According to the seeking<Rf>

And I will bring them out<WH03318><WTH8689> from the people<WH05971>, and gather<WH06908><WTH8765> them from the countries<WH0776>, and will bring<WH0935><WTH8689> them to their own land<WH0127>, and feed<WH07462><WTH8804> them upon the mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478> by the rivers<WH0650>, and in all the inhabited places<WH04186> of the country<WH0776>.

I will seek<WH01245><WTH8762> that which was lost<WH06><WTH8802>, and bring again<WH07725><WTH8686> that which was driven away<WH05080><WTH8737>, and will bind up<WH02280><WTH8799> <FI>that which was<Fi> broken<WH07665><WTH8737>, and will strengthen<WH02388><WTH8762> that which was sick<WH02470><WTH8802>: but I will destroy<WH08045><WTH8686> the fat<WH08082> and the strong<WH02389>; I will feed<WH07462><WTH8799> them with judgment<WH04941>.<CM>

And <FI>as for<Fi> you<WH0859>, O my flock<WH06629>, thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I judge<WH08199><WTH8802> between cattle<WH07716> and cattle<WH07716>, between the rams<WH0352> and the he goats<WH06260>. <RF>cattle: Heb. small cattle of lambs and kids<Rf> <RF>he goats: Heb. great he goats<Rf>

<FI> Seemeth it<Fi> a small thing<WH04592> unto you to have eaten up<WH07462><WTH8799> the good<WH02896> pasture<WH04829>, but ye must tread down<WH07429><WTH8799> with your feet<WH07272> the residue<WH03499> of your pastures<WH04829>? and to have drunk<WH08354><WTH8799> of the deep<WH04950> waters<WH04325>, but ye must foul<WH07515><WTH8799> the residue<WH03498><WTH8737> with your feet<WH07272>?

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> unto them; Behold, I, <FI>even<Fi> I, will judge<WH08199><WTH8804> between the fat<WH01274> cattle<WH07716> and between the lean<WH07330> cattle<WH07716>.

Because ye have thrust<WH01920><WTH8799> with side<WH06654> and with shoulder<WH03802>, and pushed<WH05055><WTH8762> all the diseased<WH02470><WTH8737> with your horns<WH07161>, till ye have scattered<WH06327><WTH8689> them abroad<WH02351>;
Therefore will I save<WH03467><WTH8689> my flock<WH06629>, and they shall no more be a prey<WH0957>; and I will judge<WH08199><WTH8804> between cattle<WH07716> and cattle<WH07716>.

And I will set up<WH06965><WTH8689> one<WH0259> shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802> over them, and he shall feed<WH07462><WTH8804> them, <FI>even<Fi> my servant<WH05650> David<WH01732>; he shall feed<WH07462><WTH8799> them, and he shall be their shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>.
And I the LORD<WH03068> will be their God<WH0430>, and my servant<WH05650> David<WH01732> a prince<WH05387> among<WH08432> them; I the LORD<WH03068> have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> .

And I will make<WH03772><WTH8804> with them a covenant<WH01285> of peace<WH07965>, and will cause the evil<WH07451> beasts<WH02416> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689> out of the land<WH0776>: and they shall dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> safely<WH0983> in the wilderness<WH04057>, and sleep<WH03462><WTH8804> in the woods<WH03293><WTH8675><WH03264>.

And I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> them and the places round about<WH05439> my hill<WH01389> a blessing<WH01293>; and I will cause the shower<WH01653> to come down<WH03381><WTH8689> in his season<WH06256>; there shall be showers<WH01653> of blessing<WH01293>.

And the tree<WH06086> of the field<WH07704> shall yield<WH05414><WTH8804> her fruit<WH06529>, and the earth<WH0776> shall yield<WH05414><WTH8799> her increase<WH02981>, and they shall be safe<WH0983> in their land<WH0127>, and shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, when I have broken<WH07665><WTH8800> the bands<WH04133> of their yoke<WH05923>, and delivered<WH05337><WTH8689> them out of the hand<WH03027> of those that served<WH05647><WTH8802> themselves of them.

And they shall no more be a prey<WH0957> to the heathen<WH01471>, neither shall the beast<WH02416> of the land<WH0776> devour<WH0398><WTH8799> them; but they shall dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> safely<WH0983>, and none shall make <FI>them<Fi> afraid<WH02729><WTH8688>.

And I will raise up<WH06965><WTH8689> for them a plant<WH04302> of renown<WH08034>, and they shall be no more consumed<WH0622><WTH8803> with hunger<WH07458> in the land<WH0776>, neither bear<WH05375><WTH8799> the shame<WH03639> of the heathen<WH01471> any more. <RF>of renown: or, for renown<Rf> <RF>consumed: Heb. taken away<Rf>

Thus shall they know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430> <FI>am<Fi> with them, and <FI>that<Fi> they, <FI>even<Fi> the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, <FI>are<Fi> my people<WH05971>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

And ye<WH0859> my flock<WH06629>, the flock<WH06629> of my pasture<WH04830>, <FI>are<Fi> men<WH0120>, <FI>and<Fi> I <FI>am<Fi> your God<WH0430>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
